Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for renting the Sigma 18-35 from us, and for returning it so promptly. I want to explain a deduction we made from your deposit, and I understand it's never nice to see money held back.

When the lens came back, we found a scratch on the front element. We consider this damage beyond normal wear and tear, so we deducted $160 from your $600 deposit to cover it. We believe that's fair, but we also want you to feel the process is transparent. If it would help, we can send you photos of the scratch so you can see it for yourself.

We also want to meet you partway. As a goodwill gesture, we can reduce the deduction to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you.

How would you like to proceed? Just let me know if you'd like the photos, the reduced deduction, or both, and we'll take care of it right away.

Thanks again for your understanding, Aoife. We truly appreciate your business.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
